slides.heading: He's a CEO again
body: $12B raised at a $41B valuation. JPMorgan, BlackRock, Goldman — all in.
His first CEO job since Amazon.

slides.heading: It doesn't make words — it makes things
body: Bezos calls it an 'artificial general engineer.'
AI that designs and builds real, physical products.

slides.heading: And he's not the only one
body: Same week: Nvidia + Amazon put $1.4B into humanoid robots.
The smart money is quietly leaving chatbots.

slides.heading: Here's what nobody's saying
body: Everyone's fighting over AI that types.
The next trillion is in AI that builds.

slides.heading: Now you're early
body: You're seeing it before the headlines catch up.
